name: Blender
tagline: Professional 3D creation pipeline for modeling, rigging, and rendering
description: Blender is the world-renowned free and open source 3D pipeline suite. It covers modeling, sculpting, rigging, 3D animation, simulation, GPU raytraced rendering with Cycles, video editing, and 2D storyboard drawing with Grease Pencil.
features: Cycles GPU ray-tracing with OptiX, HIP, and Vulkan backends
Advanced geometry node modeling systems
Grease Pencil 2D illustration and storyboard suite
Full Python 3 API for pipeline scripting and automation

name: KeePassXC
tagline: Secure, cross-platform password manager stored completely offline
description: KeePassXC is a modern, secure, and open-source password manager that stores and manages your most sensitive information offline in an encrypted database using AES-256 and Argon2. You can safely save your logins, credit cards, TOTP 2FA tokens, and private notes.
features: AES-256 and ChaCha20 encryption with Argon2 key derivation
Built-in Time-based One-Time Password (TOTP) authenticator
Native browser integration for Firefox, Chrome, and Brave
Auto-Type login automation on X11 and Wayland

name: Krita
tagline: Professional painting application made by artists for artists
description: Krita is a creative sketching and painting tool designed for concept artists, illustrators, matte and texture artists, and the VFX industry. It features over 100 professionally designed brushes, 9 brush engines, stabilizer support, and seamless wrap-around pattern creation.
features: Brush stabilizers for smooth inking curves
Wrap-around tiling mode for game textures and patterns
Full color management with ICC and HDR support
Integrated frame-by-frame animation workspace with audio playback
requirements: Graphics card with OpenGL 3.0 or higher

name: OBS Studio
tagline: High-performance video recording and live broadcasting software
description: OBS Studio is the gold standard for live streaming and offline screen recording on Linux. It provides low-latency capture via PipeWire and X11, multi-view production monitors, hardware-accelerated video encoding (NVENC, VA-API, QuickSync), and modular scene composition.
features: Real-time audio & video capture via PipeWire and V4L2
Hardware-accelerated NVENC, VA-API, and SVT-AV1 encoders
Audio mixer with noise gate, suppression, and gain filters
Modular Dock UI with custom web browser source plugins
requirements: OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU, PipeWire or PulseAudio

name: VSCodium
tagline: Telemetry-free, community-driven distribution of Microsoft VS Code
description: VSCodium provides binary releases of Microsoft's Visual Studio Code built from the MIT-licensed vscode repository. It completely strips all proprietary telemetry, tracking, and proprietary license agreements, giving developers a privacy-respecting code editor with complete access to debugging, syntax highlighting, and extensions.
features: Zero telemetry, tracking, or background analytics
Full TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Rust, and Go support
Open VSX Registry extension compatibility
Integrated Git source control and multi-root terminal

name: Audacity
tagline: Open-source, multi-track audio editor and recorder
description: Audacity is an easy-to-use, multi-track audio editor and recorder for Linux. Record live audio through a microphone or mixer, import sound files, edit them, combine them with other tracks, and apply extensive DSP audio effects.
features: Multi-track audio waveform and spectral editing
Real-time VST3, LV2, and LADSPA plugin support
Noise reduction, equalization, and dynamic compression
Export to MP3, WAV, FLAC, Ogg Vorbis, and Opus

name: balenaEtcher
tagline: Flash OS images to SD cards & USB drives, safely and easily.
description: balenaEtcher is a powerful OS image flasher built with web technologies to ensure flashing SD Cards or USB drives is a pleasant and safe experience. It protects you from accidentally writing to your hard-drives, and ensures every byte of data is written correctly.
features: Validated flashing prevents writing to corrupt cards
Drive Selection safety prevents scrubbing system hard-drives
Clean visual dashboard with beautiful progress percentages
Supports ISO, IMG, ZIP, DMG, and raw OS blocks

name: FreeCAD
tagline: Parametric 3D CAD modeler for mechanical engineering and product design
description: FreeCAD is an open-source parametric 3D modeler made primarily to design real-life objects of any size. Parametric modeling allows you to easily modify your design by going back into your model history and changing its parameters.
features: Complete Open CASCADE Technology geometry kernel
Modular architecture with dedicated Workbenches
Technical drawing generation (TechDraw workbench)
Comprehensive Python scripting API

name: FreeTube
tagline: An open source desktop YouTube player built with privacy in mind.
description: FreeTube is a YouTube client for Windows, Mac, and Linux built to let you use YouTube more privately. You can subscribe to creators without an account, block ads, and prevent Google from tracking you with cookies and JavaScript.
features: Watch YouTube videos without Google user tracking
Block ads, sponsor segments (SponsorBlock integration), and popups
Import/Export subscriptions completely locally
Custom playlists and local channel subscriptions

name: GIMP
tagline: Free & Open Source Image Editor with powerful photo retouching
description: GIMP is a cross-platform image editor available for Linux. Whether you are a graphic designer, photographer, illustrator, or scientist, GIMP provides you with sophisticated tools to get your job done with high quality photo manipulation and original artwork creation.
features: High quality photo retouching and digital restoration
GEGL 32-bit floating point color processing engine
Full color management with ICC profile workflows
Broad format support (XCF, PSD, TIFF, PNG, JPEG, WebP)

name: HandBrake
tagline: Open-source video transcoder for converting video from nearly any format
description: HandBrake is a tool for converting video from nearly any format to a selection of modern, widely supported codecs. It supports hardware encoding via Intel QSV, AMD VCN, and NVIDIA NVENC alongside high quality software encoders.
features: Convert video from nearly any format with built-in device presets
Hardware-accelerated encoding (NVENC, Intel QSV, AMD VCN)
Modern AV1, H.265 (HEVC), and VP9 video codec compression
Batch queuing, subtitle pass-through, and audio downmixing

name: Inkscape
tagline: Professional vector graphics editor for illustration and typography
description: Inkscape is a professional quality vector graphics software which runs on Linux. It is used by design professionals and hobbyists worldwide for creating a wide variety of graphics such as illustrations, icons, logos, diagrams, maps, and web graphics.
features: Full SVG format specification compliance
Advanced Bézier curve and node editing tools
Flexible text tool with kerning, letter spacing, and line spacing
Broad format export (PDF, EPS, SVG, PNG, WebP)

name: Joplin
tagline: An open source note taking and to-do application with end-to-end encryption
description: Joplin is an open source note taking and to-do application, which can handle a large number of notes organized into notebooks. The notes are searchable, can be copied, tagged and modified with full Markdown formatting and math equations.
features: Full Markdown notes with KaTeX math and Mermaid diagrams
End-to-End Encryption (E2EE) on all sync targets
Web Clipper extension for Firefox and Chrome
Sync with Nextcloud, Dropbox, WebDAV, or local file system

name: Kdenlive
tagline: Non-linear video editor powered by the MLT framework and KDE
description: Kdenlive is an acronym for KDE Non-Linear Video Editor. It is a powerful multi-track video editor that supports almost all audio and video formats via FFmpeg, with keyframe animation, proxy editing, auto-subtitling with Whisper AI, and color grading.
features: Multi-track video editing with timeline audio waveforms
AI Speech-to-Text subtitle generation using Whisper
Color scopes, vectorscope, RGB parade, and LUT support
Configurable keyboard shortcuts and dynamic proxy clips

name: SuperTuxKart
tagline: 3D arcade kart racer starring Tux, Beastie, and friends
description: SuperTuxKart is a 3D open-source arcade racing game featuring mascot characters of various free software projects. Race through tracks against AI or friends in local split-screen or networked multiplayer battle arenas.
features: Over 20 story tracks and multiplayer battle arenas
Networked online multiplayer and local split-screen
Full game controller and steering wheel compatibility
Custom addon manager to download user-made tracks
